name: Hex Head Screw Fully Threaded M3x0.5x6 MS 4.6 Self (DIN933)
short_description: M3 × 6 mm fully threaded hex head screw — Mild Steel, grade 4.6, Self finish (DIN 933).
description:
Built to Perform Across Industries

Hex Head Screws are built for strong and reliable fastening solutions. These are widely used across industrial, commercial and everyday applications.

### Manufacturing & Machinery
Used for machine assembly, equipment frames, guards, brackets and component mounting, where parts need to be securely fastened while remaining accessible for maintenance or replacement.

### Construction & Fabrication
Commonly used for joining steel sections, frames, supports, brackets and fabricated components. The hex head allows firm tightening with standard spanners and sockets.

### Automotive & Engineering
Used across vehicle assemblies, equipments, brackets and general engineering applications often when a strong, removable mechanical connection is required.

### Electrical & Industrial Equipment
Suitable for securing panels, enclosures, mounting plates, equipment frames and supporting components in electrical and industrial installations.

### Furniture & Fixtures
Used in metal furniture, shelving, racks, workbenches and other assembled structures, particularly where a stronger fastening solution is required than a conventional screw.

### Everyday Applications
Hex head screws are equally useful beyond industrial environments. They are commonly used for home repairs, DIY projects, assembling furniture, fixing brackets, installing shelves, repairing gates and securing metal fixtures. Their fully threaded design also makes them useful when you need flexibility in clamping components of different thicknesses.

Key Features: Fully Threaded Design – Provides maximum thread engagement for secure and adjustable fastening
Mild Steel Construction – Offers dependable strength and durability for general-purpose applications
Hexagonal Head – Allows easy installation and firm tightening using standard spanners or sockets
